name: themeparks-web
description: Theme park live ride status, wait times, virtual queues, park hours, and ride uptime history from the free ThemeParks.wiki API. Keyless. Unofficial; not affiliated with ThemeParks.wiki or any park.

THEMEPARKS_API_KEY.title: ThemeParks.wiki API key (optional)
THEMEPARKS_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave blank to run keyless; every tool works without it. A free key from https://www.themeparks.wiki/api raises the history budget from 60 to 600 calls per hour and the history window from 7 to 30 days. Sent only to api.themeparks.wiki as the x-api-key header. Never commit a key.
